## Introduction

The notebook describes the set up of the execution of the nf-core/createtaxdb benchmarking run.

## Requirements

Command line tools used in this notebook includes:

- `nextflow` (version 25.10.4 build 11173)

## Retrieving pipeline

We will benchmarking with v3.0.0 of nf-core/createtaxdb with Nextflow version 25.10.4.

```{bash}
#| eval: false
nextflow pull nf-core/createtaxdb -r 3.0.0
```

## Pipeline execution

Make a fresh screen session for safety, and move into a directory with `benchmarking/`

```{bash}
#| eval: false
screen -R ctb
mkdir createtaxdb
cd createtaxdb/
```

The final custom config files optimised for use on this particular infrastructure were for `custom_raven.config`:

```{groovy}
process {
        withName: 'SEQKIT_BATCHRENAME' {
                memory = '4.GB'
                cpus = '4'
        }
        withName: 'FIND_CONCATENATE_AA' {
                memory = '4.GB'
                cpus = '4'
        }
        withName: 'FIND_CONCATENATE_AA_KAIJU' {
                memory = '4.GB'
                cpus = '4'
        }
        withName: 'FIND_CONCATENATE_AA_KAIJU' {
                memory = '4.GB'
                cpus = '4'
        }
        withName: 'KRAKEN2_ADD' {
                memory = '4.GB'
                cpus = '4'
        }
        withName: 'KMCP_COMPUTE' {
                memory = '4.GB'
                cpus = '4'
        }
        withName: 'SYLPH_SKETCHGENOMES' {
                memory = '6.GB'
                cpus = '8'
        }
        withName: 'DIAMOND_MAKEDB' {
                memory = '12.GB'
                cpus = '8'
        }
        withName: 'KMCP_INDEX' {
                memory = '48.GB'
                cpus = '24'
        }
        withName: 'KAIJU_MKFMI' {
                memory = '100.GB'
                cpus   = '18'
        }
        withName: 'GANON_BUILDCUSTOM' {
                memory = '72.GB'
                cpus   = '18'
        }
        withName: 'KRAKEN2_BUILD'{
                memory = '240.GB'
                cpus   = '72'
        }
        withName: 'BRACKEN_BUILD'{
                memory = '240.GB'
                cpus   = '72'
        }
        withName: 'METACACHE_BUILD' {
                memory = '240.GB'
                cpus = '72'
        }
        withName: 'KRAKENUNIQ_BUILD' {
                memory = '2047.GB'
                cpus = '72'
                time = '24.h'
        }
        withName: 'CENTRIFUGE_BUILD' {
                memory = '2047.GB'
                cpus = '72'
        }
}

```

and `custom_raven_small.config`:

```{groovy}
process {
        withName: 'KRAKEN2_BUILD'{
                memory = '100.GB'
                cpus   = '36'
        }
        withName: 'BRACKEN_BUILD'{
                memory = '100.GB'
                cpus   = '36'
        }
        withName: 'METACACHE_BUILD' {
                memory = '100.GB'
                cpus = '36'
        }
        withName: 'KRAKENUNIQ_BUILD' {
                memory = '250.GB'
                cpus = '72'
                time = '24.h'
        }
        withName: 'KMCP_COMPUTE' {
                memory = '100.GB'
                cpus = '36'
        }
        withName: 'CENTRIFUGE_BUILD' {
                memory = '250.GB'
                cpus = '72'
        }
}
```

## Hard drive usage

The resulting results directory of each run are as follows.

### 30k

Command:

```{bash}
#| eval: false
nextflow run nf-core/createtaxdb \
 -r 3.0.0 \
 --input ../samplesheets/createtaxdb-samplesheet_raven30000.csv \
 -profile mpcdf,raven \
 -name benchmark_30000 \
 --outdir /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/createtaxdb/results_30000/ \
 --dbname benchmark_30000 \
 --accession2taxid /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/nucl_gb.accession2taxid \
 --prot2taxid /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/prot2taxid.map \
 --nucl2taxid /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/nucl2taxid.map \
 --nodesdmp /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/nodes.dmp \
 --namesdmp /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/names.dmp \
 --genomesizes /ptmp/jfellowsy/projects/taxprofiler-createtaxdb-paper/benchmarking/auxiliary_files/species_genome_size.txt.gz \
 --build_bracken \
 --build_centrifuge \
 --build_diamond \
 --build_ganon \
 --build_kaiju \
 --build_kmcp \
 --build_kraken2 \
 --build_krakenuniq \
 --build_sylph \
 --build_metacache \
 --generate_downstream_samplesheets \
 --generate_pipeline_samplesheets taxprofiler \
 -w work/ \
 -c custom_raven.config
```

Results directory size calculations.

```{bash}
#| eval: false
du -h --max-depth 1 results_30000/
```

Output:

```{txt}

51G     results_30000/ganon
```

### Aggregation

To aggregate all the results directory `du` commands all into one file, we can use the following:

```{bash}
#| eval: false
## Reminder, must be in `createtaxdb/`
mkdir -p ../resource_tracking/createtaxdb/
for i in results_*; do du --max-depth 1 $i >> ../resource_tracking/createtaxdb/createtaxdb_resource_usage_raw.tsv; done
for i in results_*; do du -h --max-depth 1 $i >> ../resource_tracking/createtaxdb/createtaxdb_resource_usage_humanreadable.tsv; done
```

To get all trace files

```{bash}
#| eval: false
## Reminder, must be in `createtaxdb/`
for i in results_*; do
  mkdir ../resource_tracking/createtaxdb/"$i"/
  cp -r "$i"/pipeline_info/ ../resource_tracking/createtaxdb/"$i"/pipeline_info/
done
```
